name: Standard Nuclear Inc.
summary: Standard Nuclear, Inc. is a reactor-agnostic producer of TRISO nuclear fuel, designing and manufacturing advanced nuclear fuels for next-generation reactors to support U.S. energy security. The company is the only independent U.S. manufacturer of TRISO fuel, a robust, high-performance fuel essential to advanced nuclear reactors. It aims to supply advanced fuels to the next-generation nuclear industry and deliver radioisotope power solutions.
